newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Hellaby says ready to sell 11 pct K&S stake.
newsitem.headline: Hellaby says ready to sell 11 pct K&S stake.

text.p: Investment company Hellaby Holdings Limited said on Wednesday it was prepared to accept an offer from a group of Wellington investors to buy a parcel of 550,000 shares in up-market department store Kirkcaldie and Stains for NZ$3.00 each, thereby reducing Hellaby's stake to 40 percent from its current 51 percent level.
In a statement Hellaby said it was ready to accept the offer provided the same opportunity to sell shares was given to all other K&S holders.
"In this regard a letter is being sent to Kirkcaldie & Stains shareholders," it noted.
A sale would allow Hellaby to realise $1.6 million of its investment in the retailer "while still remaining the major shareholder in the company," it added.
